Notes

A casual afternoon turns into a plea for an old friend to keep living. Withdrawal follows, but the borrowed “whatever” refrain never quite erases that care.

刚起床

The opening uses a few unadorned pieces of routine: afternoon, waking up, a call, a message. The confidence that every problem can be settled is built on those small actions. That ordinary scale makes the later direct plea to survive more intimate; the song begins close enough to daily life for care to arrive without a grand introduction.

  • Lyric transcript
百毒不侵

百毒不侵 literally declares that a hundred poisons cannot get in; 百 means all kinds rather than a counted list. It gives emotional resilience the form of bodily immunity. The preceding phone call and message make that enormous claim funny: everyday problem-solving is narrated with the invulnerability of a mythic body.

  • Genius community transcript
没有波澜

波澜 are waves or ripples, here transferred to the inner life. The speaker describes stillness immediately after firm will and immunity to poison, creating a picture of total composure. Later boredom becomes stifling and other people cannot stop. The image of calm is something the song has to preserve against a much noisier social environment.

  • Lyric transcript
世面

见世面 means acquiring social experience and seeing how the wider world works. The next line gives the resulting naivety the unexpectedly approving description “pure.” Later, the speaker sees the social scene clearly enough to want to become invisible, complicating the idea that more exposure is always better.

  • Lyric text
福气

福气 is the good fortune of a life going well. Its measure here is simply being able to eat and drink. That bodily minimum sits far below the money, fashion and rank flaunted elsewhere on the mixtape. The instruction to keep living grows out of this modest definition of a good life, rather than out of a demand to achieve more.

  • Lyric transcript
好好的活下去

活下去 means continuing to live; 好好的 adds care, safety and doing it well. The repeated 好 and the polite 请 give the command tenderness. It is not just endurance at any cost. Addressed to 老兄弟, an old friend, the line asks for the person’s continued presence before asking anything about success, usefulness or public recognition.

  • Lyric transcript
老兄弟

老 can mark familiarity or longstanding closeness rather than advanced age; 兄弟 often addresses a male friend or companion. The repeated address makes the plea to keep living feel personally directed. It need not identify a biological sibling.

  • Lyric text
吸

吸, xī, means to inhale or suck; in this social scene it insinuates drug use without naming a substance. Crucially, 我猜 means “I guess.” The line stages the speaker making a judgment from appearances—ear studs and gold teeth—then refusing further details. Keeping that distance matters more than filling the omission with a specific drug.

  • Genius community transcript
哭笑不得

哭笑不得 describes a situation too absurd or uncomfortable for either laughter or tears to feel adequate. Both responses are named and both withheld. Between stifling boredom and being speechless, the phrase makes reaction itself difficult: the speaker can observe the scene but cannot find a comfortable way to participate in it.

  • Genius community transcript
科幻电影

The scene feels so strange that watching acquaintances becomes like watching another genre of reality. This is not the director’s control claimed in “Poker Face”: the speaker sits beside the action and wants nobody to address him. The film comparison places a screen between observer and participants, preparing the wish to become transparent.

  • Lyric transcript
透明的

透明 means transparent, and the following wish explains its social purpose: nobody would stop him to talk or ask irrelevant questions. The fantasy is the reverse of demanding attention. After instructing a friend to value their existence, the speaker imagines relief in making his own presence unavailable to the surrounding crowd.

  • Lyric text
局外人

局 is a situation, arrangement or game; a 局外人 stands outside it. The next identities shrink further, from an unknown little person to an unnoticed passerby. That descending list makes anonymity desirable, a way to escape being enlisted in the romances, questions and habits of a scene that already feels exhausting.

  • Lyric transcript
小人

小人 can condemn somebody as petty or dishonorable, as in “Debt.” Here it is surrounded by being unknown, outside the group, and unnoticed, so the size meaning—an insignificant little person—fits the self-description better. The same two characters can serve contempt or self-effacement depending on their neighbors.

  • Debt lyric text
  • Lyric text
无所谓

无所谓 can dismiss a question as unimportant or announce that one no longer cares about its answer. It follows a passage full of painful observation and an earlier plea to keep living. Repetition therefore sounds like an attempt to maintain a boundary, rather than proof of effortless indifference: the voice keeps saying “whatever” because the scene keeps demanding a response.

  • Genius community transcript
谁会爱上谁

The sequence of indifference, falling in love and wearing someone down reworks the opening of Yang Kun’s “无所谓.” Here its familiar romantic resignation follows the desire to disappear from a social scene. Borrowing an already recognizable refrain supplies a ready-made way to say something the verse has struggled to express: other people’s entanglements do not have to become his own.

About Jackzebra and this mixtape

Zhuang Zhuang Mixtape arrived on Surf Gang on October 2, 2026: 55 tracks, opening with Sour and closing with Sweet. Its cast widens from YoungQueenz on Poker Face to User116, Effie, kuru, yoyi, 春 and 南部犯罪份子. Aghast has a production credit on every track from Hitman through Snatch, giving that stretch a shared collaborator behind its changing scenes.

Surf Gang release · Artist credits

Jackzebra told AVYSS that he writes while singing over a beat he has listened to repeatedly, keeping the images in his head central. He values the room Mandarin leaves for indirect meanings. Listen for ordinary phrases becoming physical scenes: familiarity becomes cooking, authority becomes family seniority, and a tired saying suddenly turns into a threat.

AVYSS interview, 2024

In STATIC, he describes mixtapes as a format for letting ideas flow, reserving an official debut album for later. In a separate conversation about Above & Beyond, he compared that earlier tape to a collection of his producer friends’ work. The credits here likewise reward attention: long-running collaborators sit alongside guests working in Mandarin, Korean and English.

STATIC interview · Sabukaru interview, 2025

The small details connect to his stated interests: he has described playing Temple Run in transit and before shows, watching Top Boy, and wanting to score White Oleander. These give the songs specific points of contact with his life. The notes follow those connections alongside the lyrics’ jokes, invented scenes and competing voices.

His recommendations in Perfectly Imperfect · Dazed interview, 2025 · Interview questionnaire, 2025

Jackzebra has pushed back on being made to represent all of China’s underground. These notes stay close to the words: what an expression usually means, what changes in this line, and how another song answers it. Cultural references have sources; interpretations rest on details you can hear or read in the song.
